title: Magazine p. 49: Gemini-11 photo of Proton-3 with enlargement (NASA S-66-54661)
description: Photocopied magazine page with a large, faint photograph (numbered 19) containing an inset enlargement of small streaks, captioned "Gemini-11 photo of Proton-3 (arrow) and extreme enlargement of image. UFO magazines often print fuzzy blobs without indicating that object was highly magnified. Film artifacts cause 'blobbiness'. NASA photo S-66-54661." The article text below introduces the Apollo-12 mission, its crew, and Conrad's radioed remark that the spacecraft was "being followed."
